verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order: the Shop Flavours CTA comes first and sits jammed against the left edge, the SOLSTICE wordmark is pushed below the headline, the three flavour pills are crammed together in reversed order, the tagline is squeezed into a ragged two-line fragment, and the legal text floats in a large dead zone on the right. B reads left to right correctly (brand, headline, copy, CTA, flavours) and keeps the headline dominant. However, the tagline is wrapped into an awkward five-line sliver, the stacked pills are jammed against the top edge, and the tiny legal text sits over the peach circle.
